description: This PHP class 'License' extends a ListableDisplayField and is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the report display plugin for licenses. It defines methods to return the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields relevant to license display in reports.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A class representing the license display field in the reporting system, providing methods to obtain related DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, which is 'Dto\-License'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the array of entity aliases used in database queries, in this case just ['license'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields relevant to this display field, here ['employee.empNumber'].
